test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

ST_FIR_STNF_ RGSTN_IRG_ _NFI_G
solution:
Given : ST_FIR_STNF_ RGSTN_IRG_ _NFI_G 

By checking options :

 
• NGSFITR → ST__N__FIR__G__STNF**__S__**RGSTN__F__IRG**__I__** __T__NFI__R__G → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• NGFISRT → ST__N__FIR__G__STNF**__F__**RGSTN**__I__**IRG__S__ **__R__**NFI**__T__**G → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• NGIFSTR → ST__**N**__FIR__**G**__STNF__**I**__RGSTN__**F**__IRG__**S**__ __**T**__NFI__**R**__G → (It follows the pattern of : STNFIRG - STNFIRG - STNFIRG - STNFIRG)
 
• NGISFRT → ST__N__FIR__G__STNF__I__RGSTN**__S__**IRG**__F__** **__R__**NFI**__T__**G → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)

⇒Option - (3) gives the pattern of "ST__N__FIR__G__ - STNF__I__RG - STN__F__IRG - __S__ __T__NFI__R__G"

Hence, "**NGIFSTR**" is the correct answer.
